scope: existing T20 shim separate egl_import.c; existing pair source unchanged
same-display dup-native-fence forwarding only for identified GL nativeFence branch
required_invariants: Use exact already-loaded surface implementation for FromNativeBuffer/DestroyWindowBuffer; do not create a bare libnative_window alias instance. Actual AHardwareBuffer consumer provenance remains a distinct binding obligation.
Reserve table slot before native wrapper creation; full table returns NULL before allocation. Native create failure releases only its reserved generation.
Serialize non-thread-safe native wrapper create/destroy through dedicated provider mutex; no driver call under table mutex.
Atomically claim CLIENT to CREATING. Duplicate tracked/busy create must reject, never fall through foreign passthrough.
Successful create stores exact display,image,implementation,windowbuffer; failed create disposes own wrapper exactly once and clears only its claimed slot.

Destroy matches (display,image), marks DESTROYING and calls saved implementation. Wrong display or duplicate destroy never drops refs. Provider destroy failure restores IMAGE and retains wrapper; success releases wrapper exactly once.

Tracked create uses unique current_display()==display; no match or ambiguous match fails without foreign-driver trial or eglGetError consumption. Such local refusal does not claim setting a new EGL error.
Destroy uses saved implementation even if current display differs on destroy thread.
Foreign inputs/targets/images use original single RTLD_NEXT entry without target conversion; validate entry is not the new shim itself.

Fence owns no fd: return provider result unchanged; choose unique current display and resolve missing driver export through that same implementation eglGetProcAddress. Unmatched fallback preserves old path only, not a verified same-implementation fix.
host_cases: native-create failure: slot reusable and no extra destroy
driver-create failure: exactly one native destroy
two concurrent create on one tracked buffer: at most one image, no passthrough
destroy failure followed by successful retry: ref retained then exactly one release
wrong display / duplicate destroy: no release
same numeric image on distinct display keys remains disambiguated
no/ambiguous current display: no driver trial and no error consumption
provider native create/destroy maximum concurrent depth=1
fence fd success/failure unchanged, no close, selected proc owner
excluded: claims of current runtime EGL winner or playback
